# Oh My DSH

> omdsh is a keyboard-first DeepSeek coding agent for the terminal, built on the DeepSeek Harness plugin runtime.

The CLI package is [@agi-fans/oh-my-dsh](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@agi-fans/oh-my-dsh). Source is [agi-fans/oh-my-dsh](https://github.com/agi-fans/oh-my-dsh). This site is the documentation source of truth.

## Docs

- [Tutorials](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/tutorials/): install, first task, context, queued turns, long sessions, environment, Skills, MCP, and plugins
- [Commands](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/commands/): the complete slash-command reference
- [Keyboard and keys](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/keyboard/): editing, overlays, and keybindings.json
- [Sessions and history](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/sessions/): durable logs, the Session Library, and local data files
- [Subagents and delegation](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/subagents/): transports, the Agent Hub, and background jobs
- [Observability](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/observability/): the trajectory ledger, context usage, and diffs
- [Settings](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/settings/): appearance, motion, notifications, and the status line
- [Permissions and access](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/permissions/): access presets, sandbox, and approvals
- [Command line](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/cli/): flags, subcommands, and environment variables
- [Tools](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/tools/): what the model can use, grouped by capability
- [Troubleshooting](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/troubleshooting/): exit, color, scrollback, and boot failures
- [Skills and MCP](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/skills-and-mcp/): reusable instructions and external tools
- [User plugins](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/plugins/): install DSH bundles with `omdsh plugin`
- [Architecture](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/architecture/): plugin boundaries and runtime data flow
- [Performance](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/docs/performance/): TUI benchmarks and rendering methodology
- [Changelog](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/changelog/): user-visible releases

Simplified Chinese lives under `/zh/`, for example [教程](https://vanducng.github.io/oh-my-dsh/zh/docs/tutorials/).
